note: Reference run of the campaign rule: the research engine (convexity team, t2/engine.mjs) on ten OKX perpetual swaps, 12-hour bars from 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-04 12:00 UTC, funding as recorded (Binance history as the proxy), long only, structure L10-unit-EX10 with entry BO20. Trimmed from t2/campaigns.json (.okx, written 2026-10-04) to what `pnpm backtest:campaign --check` needs. In campaigns, mult and peak are the values published there (4 and 3 decimals); multExact and peakExact are the same run before rounding, written by the unchanged engine from the same data on 2026-10-05 (all 497 round to the published values). warmup holds the daily bars that run had before each instrument's first OKX daily bar, the last 20 of them: Binance spot days and, for LINK, ADA and DOT, the half day their OKX history begins with. Eight campaigns of January 2020 were opened on channels that reach into these bars. noadd is the published total of the same rule without adds (the "add=none" neighbour). fee, slippage, exitSlippage and maintenance are what the engine assumed; majors names the coins of the lower tier.
